import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.QuotScheme
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.GlueDescent
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.QuasicoherentAffineCriterion
import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.TildeExactness
import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.CechHigherDirectImageUnconditional

/-!
# Quasi-coherence of kernels and cokernels

For a morphism of quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-modules, kernels and cokernels remain
quasi-coherent. On an affine scheme this is obtained from the exact tilde
functor and the affine QC/tilde essential-image equivalence. The general case
is obtained by pulling back to the affine-open cover and applying the local
criterion `isQuasicoherent_of_affine_pullback`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open CategoryTheory Limits

universe u

namespace AlgebraicGeometry
namespace Scheme
namespace Modules

variable {R : CommRingCat.{u}}

/-! The affine kernel/cokernel steps are public so downstream local criteria can
reuse the exactness argument without introducing a second affine proof. -/

/-- Kernel of a morphism between quasi-coherent modules on an affine scheme. -/
theorem kernel_isQuasicoherent_affine {A B : (Spec R).Modules} (ψ : A ⟶ B)
    (hA : A.IsQuasicoherent) (hB : B.IsQuasicoherent) :
    (kernel ψ).IsQuasicoherent := by
  obtain ⟨M, ⟨eA⟩⟩ := essImage_tilde_of_isQuasicoherent A hA
  obtain ⟨N, ⟨eB⟩⟩ := essImage_tilde_of_isQuasicoherent B hB
  let ψ' : (tilde.functor R).obj M ⟶ (tilde.functor R).obj N := eA.hom ≫ ψ ≫ eB.inv
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ : ∃ f : M ⟶ N, (tilde.functor R).map f = ψ' :=
    ⟨(tilde.functor R).preimage ψ', (tilde.functor R).map_preimage ψ'⟩
  have hker : (kernel ψ').IsQuasicoherent := by
    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits (tilde.functor R) := tildePreservesFiniteLimits
    let eK := PreservesKernel.iso (tilde.functor R) f
    let eK' : kernel ((tilde.functor R).map f) ≅ kernel ψ' :=
      kernel.mapIso ((tilde.functor R).map f) ψ' (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (by simpa [hf])
    exact (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent.{u} (Spec R).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
      (eK ≪≫ eK')
      (presentationTilde.{u} (kernel f) Set.univ (by simp) _ (Submodule.span_eq _)).isQuasicoherent
  let eψ : kernel ψ ≅ kernel ψ' := kernel.mapIso ψ ψ' eA.symm eB.symm (by simp [ψ'])
  exact (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent.{u} (Spec R).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso eψ.symm hker

/-- Cokernel of a morphism between quasi-coherent modules on an affine scheme. -/
theorem cokernel_isQuasicoherent_affine {A B : (Spec R).Modules} (ψ : A ⟶ B)
    (hA : A.IsQuasicoherent) (hB : B.IsQuasicoherent) :
    (cokernel ψ).IsQuasicoherent := by
  obtain ⟨M, ⟨eA⟩⟩ := essImage_tilde_of_isQuasicoherent A hA
  obtain ⟨N, ⟨eB⟩⟩ := essImage_tilde_of_isQuasicoherent B hB
  let ψ' : (tilde.functor R).obj M ⟶ (tilde.functor R).obj N := eA.hom ≫ ψ ≫ eB.inv
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ : ∃ f : M ⟶ N, (tilde.functor R).map f = ψ' :=
    ⟨(tilde.functor R).preimage ψ', (tilde.functor R).map_preimage ψ'⟩
  have hcok : (cokernel ψ').IsQuasicoherent := by
    letI : PreservesFiniteColimits (tilde.functor R) := tilde_preservesFiniteColimits
    let eC := PreservesCokernel.iso (tilde.functor R) f
    let eC' : cokernel ((tilde.functor R).map f) ≅ cokernel ψ' :=
      cokernel.mapIso ((tilde.functor R).map f) ψ' (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (by simpa [hf])
    exact (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent.{u} (Spec R).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
      (eC ≪≫ eC')
      (presentationTilde.{u} (cokernel f) Set.univ (by simp) _
        (Submodule.span_eq _)).isQuasicoherent
  let eψ : cokernel ψ ≅ cokernel ψ' := cokernel.mapIso ψ ψ' eA.symm eB.symm (by simp [ψ'])
  exact (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent.{u} (Spec R).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso eψ.symm hcok

/-- Kernel of a morphism between quasi-coherent modules on an arbitrary scheme. -/
theorem kernel_isQuasicoherent {X : Scheme.{u}} {A B : X.Modules} (ψ : A ⟶ B)
    (hA : A.IsQuasicoherent) (hB : B.IsQuasicoherent) :
    (kernel ψ).IsQuasicoherent := by
  refine isQuasicoherent_of_affine_pullback (X := X) (kernel ψ) ?_
  intro U
  let F := pullback U.2.fromSpec
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits F := inferInstance
  have hAU : (F.obj A).IsQuasicoherent := isQuasicoherent_pullback_fromSpec A U.2
  have hBU : (F.obj B).IsQuasicoherent := isQuasicoherent_pullback_fromSpec B U.2
  have hK : (kernel (F.map ψ)).IsQuasicoherent :=
    kernel_isQuasicoherent_affine (F.map ψ) hAU hBU
  exact (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent.{u} (Spec Γ(X, U.1)).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    (PreservesKernel.iso F ψ).symm hK

/-- Cokernel of a morphism between quasi-coherent modules on an arbitrary scheme. -/
theorem cokernel_isQuasicoherent {X : Scheme.{u}} {A B : X.Modules} (ψ : A ⟶ B)
    (hA : A.IsQuasicoherent) (hB : B.IsQuasicoherent) :
    (cokernel ψ).IsQuasicoherent := by
  refine isQuasicoherent_of_affine_pullback (X := X) (cokernel ψ) ?_
  intro U
  let F := pullback U.2.fromSpec
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits F := inferInstance
  have hAU : (F.obj A).IsQuasicoherent := isQuasicoherent_pullback_fromSpec A U.2
  have hBU : (F.obj B).IsQuasicoherent := isQuasicoherent_pullback_fromSpec B U.2
  have hC : (cokernel (F.map ψ)).IsQuasicoherent :=
    cokernel_isQuasicoherent_affine (F.map ψ) hAU hBU
  exact (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent.{u} (Spec Γ(X, U.1)).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    (PreservesCokernel.iso F ψ).symm hC

end Modules
end Scheme
end AlgebraicGeometry
